page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g7t.16xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 64 vCPUs mapped to 32 physical cores of an Intel Xeon 8369B processor running at 2.7 GHz. The instance is equipped with 256.0 GB of system memory, yielding a balanced 4.0 GB of RAM per core. It has no local storage and relies on network-attached storage, supported by a baseline network bandwidth of 32 Gbps.

Benchmark data shows strong multi-core performance across several tests. The instance achieves a strong rating in stress-ng multi-core CPU performance and Geekbench multi-core. Multi-threaded tasks such as bzip3 decompression, software compilation with Clang, ray tracing, and image processing all register strong results. Single-core metrics, including stress-ng single-core and Geekbench single-core, fall within the average range. Memory bandwidth tests and static web serving throughput also demonstrate average performance.

The processor includes hardware-accelerated instruction sets such as AVX-512 Foundation and AVX-512 VNNI, which contribute to strong performance in Passmark CPU encryption and small-scale LLM inference. For database workloads, the instance registers strong Passmark database operations, while Redis SET operations remain average. Given its dedicated CPU allocation and high resource density without bundled local storage or GPUs, the instance offers balanced qualitative cost efficiency for multi-threaded enterprise workloads, software compilation, and database hosting.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g7t.16xlarge is a general-purpose instance featuring 64 vCPUs and 256.0 GB of RAM, powered by a 2.7 GHz Intel Xeon 8369B processor with 32 physical cores. Operating on the KVM hypervisor, this x86_64 instance provides dedicated CPU allocation and 32 Gbps of baseline network bandwidth, though it lacks local storage and GPU accelerators. Performance benchmarks indicate strong multi-core capabilities, particularly in multi-threaded decompression, software compilation, ray tracing, and database operations. Single-core performance and memory bandwidth remain average. The CPU supports AVX-512 and cryptographic extensions, facilitating strong performance in encryption and small-scale LLM inference. This instance is suited for multi-threaded enterprise applications, software compilation, and database workloads.
